title: Terms & Conditions
summary: These development terms describe the proposed baseline for using the Round Logics storefront and placing an order.

blocks.text: These Terms & Conditions are a controlled development draft for the website and related shopping services presented under the Round Logics brand. The final legal entity, operating model, and approved wording must be confirmed before publication.

This document is not legal advice and should not be treated as final client-approved terms. Product, order, payment, and support experiences may contain additional information relevant to a particular transaction.

By accessing the website, creating an account, or placing an order, a customer may be asked to acknowledge the applicable terms and policies. The final consent language, records, and policy versioning must be approved before production use.

items: Read the documents that apply to your activity before placing an order.
Use the checkout acknowledgement only when you have reviewed the linked documents.
Contact support if you need clarification before completing a purchase.

blocks.text: The storefront is presented under the name Round Logics and is associated with Pirates Corp for development context. The legal entity responsible for the platform has not yet been confirmed.

blocks.text: The final eligibility requirements, including any age or capacity restrictions, must be confirmed for the products and services offered through this storefront. Customers should use the website only where they are permitted to do so by applicable law.

Where account registration is available, customers are responsible for providing accurate information and taking reasonable steps to protect their sign-in credentials. The final account recovery, verification, and security procedures remain subject to confirmation.

items: Provide information that is accurate, current, and relevant to the order.
Do not misuse the website, payment flow, account system, or another person’s information.
Do not attempt to interfere with the availability, security, or normal operation of the platform.
Use product information and instructions responsibly and seek clarification where information is incomplete.

blocks.text: Product names, descriptions, images, attributes, stock information, and prices are displayed for shopping decisions and may require correction or confirmation. The final product catalogue, seller model, country-of-origin disclosures, and other product-specific information must be reviewed for the business model.
Where a product page links to shipping, cancellation, return, refund, replacement, or warranty information, the dedicated policy document should be read together with the product information.

The applicable price, taxes, delivery charges, discounts, and offer conditions should be shown before an order is submitted. Any prior-price comparison, promotion condition, seller disclosure, or tax treatment must be confirmed for the relevant transaction before this draft is approved.

Submitting an order is a request to purchase the selected products. The final rules for order acceptance, stock errors, duplicate orders, fraud screening, and cancellation by the platform must be confirmed and documented in the approved version.

Available payment methods are shown during checkout. Payment processing may involve third-party providers presented in the checkout flow. The approved version must identify applicable payment, chargeback, failed-payment, and payment-security information without claiming providers or capabilities that are not in use.

Shipping availability, delivery estimates, serviceable locations, charges, tracking, and delivery exceptions are described in the Shipping Policy. No delivery promise is made by this development draft.

Cancellation eligibility depends on order status and the approved business rules. See the Cancellation Policy for the implementation placeholder and the final terms once the cancellation window and post-dispatch handling are confirmed.

Return eligibility, non-returnable products, damaged or incorrect deliveries, replacement handling, refund method, and refund timing are not confirmed. See the Returns, Refunds & Replacement Policy for controlled placeholders.

The final approved terms should identify the rights holder for the storefront, brand assets, software, product content, and other materials, together with the permissions granted to customers for ordinary shopping use.

The platform may link to or use services operated by third parties. Their own terms and privacy notices may apply. The final document must identify relevant providers only after they have been verified in the deployed architecture.

The website may be updated, unavailable, or affected by events outside the platform’s control. Any disclaimer must be reviewed by the client and legal advisers so that it accurately reflects consumer rights and the services actually provided.

The policy source supports version, effective-date, and last-updated metadata so approved changes can be reviewed and linked to the experience. The final notice and transition process must be confirmed before publication.

The grievance officer, nodal officer, escalation method, and applicable response commitments are [GRIEVANCE OFFICER — TO BE CONFIRMED]. Do not treat the general development contact below as a statutory grievance officer or legal-notice address.
Governing law and jurisdiction: [JURISDICTION — TO BE CONFIRMED]. This placeholder must be replaced only after client and legal review.

For general development-stage questions about these policies, use the verified contact details shown in the contact card on this page. Those details are not a statement that the supplied address is a registered office.

title: Privacy Policy
summary: This development draft provides the structure for explaining how personal data may be handled by the storefront once the actual data flows are confirmed.

blocks.text: This Privacy Policy is a development draft for the Round Logics storefront. It is designed to be replaced with client-approved content after the application data flows, vendors, retention practices, and legal roles have been verified.

Depending on the feature used, the storefront may process information supplied by a customer, such as account, contact, address, order, and support details. The definitive list must be derived from the deployed application and approved privacy notice.

items: Provide and administer requested shopping, account, and order functionality.
Respond to support or contact requests.
Maintain security, prevent misuse, and troubleshoot the service.
Meet other purposes that are clearly disclosed and approved for the actual product.

blocks.text: This list is structural and does not confirm that each purpose is currently active.

Account, billing, shipping, order, and customer-service fields should be documented with their purpose and required status in the approved notice. Do not add fields or uses to the final policy without verifying the application and operational workflows.

Payment details may be collected or handled through payment providers shown in checkout. The approved notice must explain the actual payment data boundary and must not claim that the storefront stores or does not store a particular payment field without verification.

The actual deployment should be audited for server logs, device information, identifiers, security telemetry, analytics, and performance measurement before this section is approved. No analytics provider or retention period is claimed here.

Cookie categories, consent choices, storage duration, and third-party technologies must be documented from the actual runtime configuration. This draft does not claim that a particular cookie, analytics tool, or advertising pixel is in use.

The final notice must identify the categories of recipients that actually receive personal data, why they receive it, and how the customer can contact the responsible organisation. This development version does not name vendors, ad networks, processors, or other recipients.

The approved notice may describe appropriate safeguards without exposing security-sensitive details. Retention periods are [RETENTION PERIODS — TO BE CONFIRMED] and should be based on actual operational, tax, accounting, support, security, and legal requirements.

The approved notice should explain the rights and choices available to individuals, how to exercise them, how consent can be withdrawn where applicable, and how complaints can be raised. The responsible legal role and process are [PRIVACY CONTACT / DATA PROTECTION ROLE — TO BE CONFIRMED].

The client must confirm whether the products or services are directed to children and whether international transfers or remote access are involved. This draft makes no age-related or location-related claim.
This content model tracks versions and dates so approved updates can be communicated clearly. The final change-notice process is [TO BE CONFIRMED].
General development-stage questions can be sent to the supplied contact details shown on this page. The statutory privacy contact, grievance officer, and legal entity are [TO BE CONFIRMED].

title: Cancellation Policy
summary: Clear guidelines explaining when an order can be cancelled and how refunds are automatically processed.

blocks.text: We want you to be completely satisfied with your purchase. You can easily cancel eligible orders directly from your account page before shipping has been initiated.

You can cancel your order self-service as long as it is in Pending, On-Hold, or Processing status and has not yet been assigned a courier tracking number (AWB). Once an AWB is generated and shipment is initiated, self-service cancellation is disabled.

Once a tracking number has been assigned or the order has been handed to the courier partner, the order cannot be cancelled directly. If you need assistance, you can contact our WhatsApp support team or wait for delivery and initiate a return within the return window.

For prepaid orders (paid via Credit/Debit Cards, UPI, Net Banking, Razorpay, or Stripe), cancelling your order automatically initiates a full refund of 100% of your payment (including all product and shipping charges) back to your original payment method. The refund is typically reflected in your bank account or card within 5 to 7 business days. For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, no payment was made, so the order is immediately cancelled without any financial transaction.
If you have any questions regarding order cancellation, please reach out to our customer support team through our WhatsApp helpline or email us.

title: Returns, Refunds & Replacement
summary: Our 7-day return policy, eligibility conditions, proof requirements, and refund calculation rules.

blocks.text: We stand behind the quality of our products. If you are not satisfied with your purchase or if you receive a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, you can request a return within 7 days of delivery.

Returns can be requested directly from your account within 7 days of the confirmed delivery date. The deadline applies to submitting your return request online, after which our team will arrange the reverse pickup.

Returned items must be in their original condition, unused, and with original packaging, tags, and accessories intact. Consumable items that have been extensively used or altered may not be eligible for a refund.

If you received a damaged item, manufacturing defect, or wrong item, please select the appropriate reason and upload clear photos showing the issue during the return request. Upon verification, you will receive a full refund of 100% of the item cost plus shipping charges.
The refund amount depends on the return reason:

items: Damaged, Defective, or Wrong Item: Full refund of 100% of the product cost plus original shipping charges.
Changed Mind or Other Reason: Refund of the product cost (excluding shipping charges).

blocks.text: For prepaid orders, the refund is processed automatically to your original payment method once the returned item is received and inspected at our warehouse. For COD orders, our support team will disburse the refund to your designated UPI ID or bank account within 3-5 business days of receipt.

Once your return request is approved by our team, a courier partner will be assigned to collect the item from your delivery address. After receipt and quick verification at our facility, the refund status will update in your account.
For questions about returns or reverse logistics, contact our customer service team via WhatsApp or email.
